repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until((#Main_SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound > 30 and (#Bedroom_SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound <= 30)
triggered = false
}
wait until((#Main_SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound > 30 or (#Bedroom_SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound > 30)
all(#AirPurifier).airPurifier_setAirPurifierMode("sleep")
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait for Sound > 30 before calling the action. The candidate uses a periodic `if` which only evaluates at the start of the 1000ms cycle. At t=100ms, the condition became true, but the candidate's `if` had not yet executed, so the action was missed. The fix implements the rising-edge state machine: block until the edge occurs, then execute the body.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a blocking rising-edge wait (`wait until` with `triggered` state) followed by the action and state update, matching the IR's `cycle { wait(rising); call }` structure.
